Update the name of one or more schools

Source: R/manual_class_list_functions.R
update_school_name.Rd

Update the name of one or more schools

Usage

update_school_name(data, new_name, ...)

Arguments

data

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

new_name

Replacement school name(s); one per selected school identifier.

...

Exactly one named school identifier, using an internal lookup key or configured external name, e.g. `URN = 123456`, `EST_ID = '001'`, or `est_wonde_id = 'A123'`.
